extraction.Name: Irene Huggins (Ross)
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded May 25, 1918, by Robert S. Huggins.
extraction.Buyer: Irene Huggins Ross and William Ross conveyed the land by deed to Robert S. Huggins for $1.00
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612739 issued; Northwest quarter section 21, township 95, north of range [not fully stated]; receipt signed by allottee in February 1918; conveyance dated May 25, 1918; document dated June 1929
